sanskrit_verse:
भाण्डपिण्डव्ययोद्धार भारसारान्ववेक्षणम्
कुर्युस्तेSव्यभिचारेण समये स्वे व्यवस्थिताः
transliteration:
bhāṇḍapiṇḍavyayoddhāra bhārasārānvavekṣaṇam
kuryus te 'vyabhicāreṇa samaye sve vyavasthitāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Those established in their appointed time must invariably carry out the elevation of substance-loss and the examination of weight-value without deviation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently within svadharma-appointed roles
Causation aligns with sequential dharmic function
Capacity-based responsibility is time-bound and role-specific
Restoration logic operates through precise functional execution
Consciousness alignment occurs via adherence to svakāla-vyavasthā
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.is_appointed_to_role AND current_time.equals(appointment_period): THEN execute_substance_loss_elevation()
IF deviation_occurs IN functional_execution: THEN halt_process AND initiate_re_alignment_protocol()
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, only those whose svakāla-vyavasthā aligns with the case domain may deliberate; deviation from prescribed function nullifies authority and necessitates realignment prior to continuation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that misalignment stems from unexamined substance-loss or undervalued responsibility; correction follows sequential realignment rather than punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate vyavahāra-pratipūraṇa until svakāla-dharma is restored
Deploy śuddhi-kramaḥ to cleanse causal distortions in duty execution
Enforce sākṣātkriyā-upāyaḥ to reinstate capacity-aware alignment
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed—non-punitive, consciousness-rooted, and eternally aligned with svakāla-vyavasthā.
